integrity: Proof is self-contained; an independent external scientific audit and independent validation have not been performed. The separate finite-state arithmetic checker is supporting evidence rather than a proof for all sizes.
scientific_limitations: Applies to binary three-agent majority updates on a fixed connected one-hub three-uniform sunflower with disjoint pairs and positive fixed edge probabilities. I.i.d. initialization required only for unconditional formulas. Does not establish any corresponding law for overlapping petals, changed update rules, or adaptive hypergraphs.
title: Exact consensus and persistent-disagreement law for weighted majority-rule sunflowers
